semantics.depends_on: Research prerequisites: a resolved counterexample is usable knowledge, not a positive premise. Assembly additionally checks required_verdicts.
semantics.status: resolved means an existing source packet supplies the stated scoped result; open means research remains. Receipts are recorded, not independently replayed by the population checker.
semantics.verdict: constructed, rejected, or open at the EXACT node scope. Formal ++/+-/-+/-- outcomes remain null until their criteria are fixed and reviewed.
semantics.references: Cross-net scope references are not local dependency edges. Branch projections share these node identities rather than copying outcomes.
semantics.revision: Change a map, form, domain, operation or source choice by adding a successor candidate; retain its predecessor and counterexample. Re-pin explicitly after reviewing changed source files.
semantics.frontier: Open nodes whose local dependencies are resolved. Broader formulation and physics programme nodes do not block bounded RH research. No automatic outcome propagation.

conjectures.statement: The declared 12-to-4 projection and generic shifted-comb attachment intertwine the source permutation and Fourier; the full source is reconstructed with its hidden record.
conjectures.scope: 0<a<1, a!=1/2; chosen comb seed and Fourier convention; rank-four analytic quotient, not an injective twelve-coordinate analytic map.
conjectures.acceptance: Reuse R_a C12=F R_a, its skew-generator square and x=E I_a^-1 R_a x+Nx.
conjectures.falsifier: A source column fails a commuting square or reconstruction.
conjectures.retained_data: Nx; zero-atom endpoint; all four Fourier characters; coefficient Gram distinct from analytic test-space form.

conjectures.statement: Actual retained histories attach to the Fourier continuous generator; the full endpoint reader supplies four coordinates and coherent section transport.
conjectures.scope: Declared endpoint chart J and complementary basis; existing active generator unchanged; full history hidden component retained.
conjectures.acceptance: Reuse D J=J A_endpoint and transported full sections, with exact reconstruction.
conjectures.falsifier: Independent stage section choices break extension/generator coherence.
conjectures.retained_data: Complementary endpoint coordinates and endpoint-invisible histories; native incidence M remains a separate operation.

conjectures.statement: Candidate identification of the native history discrete tick with Fourier through a fixed nonzero endpoint map.
conjectures.scope: Actual native M with characteristic polynomial (x^2+x+1)(x^2-x-1); fixed attachments.
conjectures.acceptance: A nonzero solution of F X=X M.
conjectures.falsifier: Disjoint spectra force X=0; this is the recorded result.
conjectures.counterexample: Order-three active tick and golden-ratio complementary modes do not equal the Fourier roots. A stage-dependent frame changes the candidate.

conjectures.statement: The parity-resolved 12->11->10->9->8->6->4 route transports the full Fourier permutation at every stage and has the original final projection.
conjectures.scope: Repaired frame, not the original generator-only frame.
conjectures.acceptance: All six permutation, generator, metric, energy and reconstruction squares; composite projection exactly P.
conjectures.falsifier: P_m C12 N_m is nonzero at an intermediate stage.
conjectures.counterexample: Original frame leakage ranks 1,2,1,0,0,0; preserve this control when changing the frame.

conjectures.statement: The unshifted comb specialization reaches theta/Mellin Lambda and xi with its zero-atom and endpoint-dilation correction.
conjectures.scope: Analytic image rank one; four-port kernel dimension three, twelve-coordinate kernel dimension eleven. Poisson/Mellin analysis reused from source notes.
conjectures.acceptance: Track coefficient sum, delta_0 <-> 1 under Fourier, endpoint determinant s(s-1), and boundary constant 1/2.
conjectures.falsifier: Four independent Riemann ports asserted after specialization, or zero-removed comb treated as self-Fourier.
conjectures.retained_data: Lost labelled coefficients/history and boundary span {Delta,delta_0,1}; active rotor specializes to zero.

conjectures.statement: j_h delta_n=delta_(hn) intertwines lattice Fourier with real Fourier via periodic lifting, preserving source operations and dyadic bonding.
conjectures.scope: Finite packets and stated tempered-distribution/l2 extension; multichannel extension separate from one-dimensional selection.
conjectures.acceptance: F_R j_h=L_h F; shift/modulation Weyl phase, convolution, refinement and radial/Mellin composition.
conjectures.falsifier: Use exponential positions while claiming additive composition, or treat atoms as real-line L2 functions.
conjectures.retained_data: Mesh/time conventions, zero endpoint, induced test/dual domains; log|hn| rather than hn in radial coordinates.

conjectures.statement: On the declared analytic test space, divisor evaluation is dense in weighted l2, the radical is ker E, and the signed form is <CEf,Eg>.
conjectures.scope: Analytic register and half-divisor normalization. Auxiliary positive norm and signed Weil form are different; scalar evaluation retains multiplicity as weights.
conjectures.acceptance: Reuse translation covariance, density argument and radical calculation; distinguish conditional positive completion from unconditional signed covariance.
conjectures.falsifier: Use isotropic cone as radical, covariance as positivity, or scalar evaluation weights as independent multiplicity eigendirections.

conjectures.statement: Candidate: either complete source coefficient metric or complete Hamiltonian is the Weil pullback through the existing analytic attachment.
conjectures.scope: G12=10I+J, declared K12 at alpha=1/2, actual R_a and R_0, full source; second witness lies in visible four-plane.
conjectures.acceptance: Source form annihilates ker R and equals the target form on the fixed domain.
conjectures.falsifier: h=14e_AB-e_AD-e_CA-e_DB-e_BC maps to zero but has norm 2100 and H=980; v=e_AD-e_BC maps to zero under R_0 but has norm=H=20.
conjectures.counterexample: Both exact kernel witnesses; nonzero scalar rescaling cannot repair them. Retaining Nx in an archive does not put its energy into the analytic readout.

conjectures.statement: The existing rowspace observer recovers the complete twelve-arrow Hamiltonian using six active coordinates and six retained zero-energy coordinates.
conjectures.scope: Same source D12 and original energy normalization; not a Weil-test map or a four-coordinate energy factorization.
conjectures.acceptance: K12=P_active^T K_active P_active, full reconstruction, source-tick intertwining, and exact recovery of energies 980 and 20.
conjectures.falsifier: Either old energy witness is lost, source normalization changes, or a four-row reader is asserted to factor a rank-six Hessian.
conjectures.retained_data: Six stationary zero-energy coordinates; they still carry positive coefficient norm. This repairs the reader, not the rejected analytic map.

conjectures.statement: Candidate: the direct scalar-test skew-Fourier extension of the recovered source energy equals the Weil quadratic form.
conjectures.scope: Declared identification of scalar Fourier coordinate with Weil logarithmic test coordinate; not every alternative test map.
conjectures.acceptance: Equality on the declared test domain, including even Gaussians, under the unchanged source energy convention.
conjectures.falsifier: H_F(f)=10||f_odd||^2 is zero on the certified even Gaussian while its half-divisor Weil value is strictly positive.
conjectures.counterexample: t=1/10, frequency centre 0: rotor energy 0; certified Weil value about 2.104799795822351e-9. Prime term about -0.16280551750403715.

conjectures.statement: Freeze the stage and comparison-cell inventory for the existing bounded RH realization.
conjectures.scope: Actual finite coefficient, retained-history, distribution, test-dual and Mellin stages; inventory only, not proof of transport.
conjectures.acceptance: Assign stable stage/map/cell IDs; record types, domains, operations, supplied choices, kernels/retained data and evidence pointers. Every required cell has an owner child and explicit open or evidenced state; independent sources are not silently identified.
conjectures.falsifier: A stage or cell lacks its actual source/domain, or an inventory entry is counted as a compatibility proof.
conjectures.next_action: Extract the dictionary from existing RH maps and typed WG sources; list operation, continuation and completion cells without constructing another generic framework.
conjectures.deliverable: Versioned stage/map/cell dictionary with evidence and unresolved-choice inventory.

conjectures.statement: Verify the frozen operation and composition comparison cells.
conjectures.scope: Only generators and compositions enumerated in the dictionary; native extension and Fourier operations remain distinct.
conjectures.acceptance: Every required operation/composition cell has a typed commuting witness or an explicitly scoped replacement excluding the falsified candidate. Reuse old-frame leakage and native-tick mismatch controls; no omitted failed cell is marked proved.
conjectures.falsifier: A required generator or composition disagrees between routes, or a native tick is silently replaced by Fourier.
conjectures.next_action: Replay finite intertwiners against the frozen cells, then test the first uncovered composition.
conjectures.deliverable: Cell-indexed operation/composition witnesses and executable mismatch regressions.

conjectures.statement: Verify task-relative identity and licensed continuation transport for the frozen stages.
conjectures.scope: Fixed observation contexts, retained source data and permitted future operations; no universal equivalence from scalar equality.
conjectures.acceptance: Each required identity/continuation cell specifies equivalence, kernel, reconstruction or retained distinctions and transported future witnesses. Test rank-one specialization and an equal-readout/different-future pair. Apply ideal-attachment or half-phase controls only after a documented source binding.
conjectures.falsifier: Equal current readouts are identified despite a permitted future distinction, or source-action attachments become unrelated archived coordinates.
conjectures.next_action: Declare task-relative equivalences and compare two retained states with the same Riemann readout; audit applicability of Strominger controls without imposing an unbound carrier.
conjectures.deliverable: Cell-indexed identity/continuation witnesses, reconstruction data and counterexample controls.

conjectures.statement: Verify domain and completion transport for the frozen analytic comparison cells.
conjectures.scope: Distribution, test-dual and Mellin transitions under declared conventions; not source-form equality or positivity.
conjectures.acceptance: Each required analytic cell declares domain, topology, normalization and map with appropriate continuity, density/extension and limit-transport witnesses. Distinguish supplied analytic choices from carrier-derived laws.
conjectures.falsifier: A comparison is used outside its domain, extension changes normalization, or finite agreement substitutes for completion proof.
conjectures.next_action: Inventory existing extension arguments against dictionary cells and audit the first missing domain/topology witness.
conjectures.deliverable: Cell-indexed analytic-domain/completion ledger and extension/limit witnesses.

conjectures.statement: Assemble and review the four scoped stagewise-interface witnesses for the mathematical branch.
conjectures.scope: One frozen dictionary and compatible maps/domains across all children; reuse existing generic WG composition.
conjectures.acceptance: All four children are constructed; every required dictionary cell is accounted for, and operation, continuation and analytic witnesses agree on overlaps. Review against the mathematical branch interface without inferring universal realization.
conjectures.falsifier: Children use incompatible source/map/domain conventions, a required cell remains unproved, or inventory/rejection substitutes for a constructed witness.
conjectures.next_action: After all four child gates close, compose cell-indexed witnesses and review overlaps; a filled table alone cannot close this parent.
conjectures.deliverable: Reviewed bounded stagewise-interface assembly with four incoming witness references.

conjectures.statement: Identify a concrete common constructor for the canonical channel lattice and twelve-arrow/retained-history sources.
conjectures.scope: Keep the additive lattice coordinate distinct from previous logarithmic prime grades and distinguish native extension from Fourier.
conjectures.acceptance: Specify objects and native operations on one source, maps to both realizations, and commuting composition/continuation squares on generators.
conjectures.falsifier: Map chosen only from equal dimensions or spectra, exponential positions substituted for additive positions, or a native tick silently replaced.
conjectures.next_action: Freeze a common source generator dictionary including the supplied mark, axis-domain policy and retained geometric/off-axis data; test one nontrivial composition through both routes. Do not identify the conditional axis task with the full triangulation source.
conjectures.deliverable: Common-source map with generator-level commuting squares and explicit unmatched operations.

conjectures.statement: Candidate: the permutation-symmetric coordinate-sum quotient carries the full channel quadratic heat to the ordinary one-dimensional theta lattice.
conjectures.scope: D>=2, finite packets with Q(n)=sum n_d^2 and claimed l2/full-comb extension; unchanged source heat.
conjectures.acceptance: Addition, refinement, heat and completed comb transport all descend through the same sum map.
conjectures.falsifier: Equal sum labels have different quadratic heat, or fibre summation is unbounded.
conjectures.counterexample: e1-e2 and 0 have sum zero but Q=2 and Q=0; M-point sum-zero fibre has squared norm ratio M.
conjectures.next_action: Retain exclusion; any weighted or narrowed source is a successor candidate.

conjectures.statement: The explicitly pointed universal channel source admits a one-dimensional axis selection with retained complement and mark-covariant operation transport.
conjectures.scope: Supplied mark j; axis subalgebra or listed kernel-stable unary operations; no full geometric/physical/canonical selection.
conjectures.acceptance: Reconstruction, marked symmetry, Fourier/refinement and restricted heat/theta squares agree without discarding transverse boundary factors.
conjectures.falsifier: Unrestricted convolution or fixed-mark permutations leak retained directions into the reader, or a D-dimensional axis comb is called self-Fourier.
conjectures.next_action: Use only after binding the same mark/domain into the other source route.
conjectures.deliverable: Pointed-source selector and preserved unmarked/full-heat exclusions.

conjectures.statement: Supply a source rule selecting the one-dimensional zeta lattice from the multichannel construction.
conjectures.scope: Selection/quotient must account for channel permutations, lost directions, physical mesh and heat-time choices.
conjectures.acceptance: Specify selection map, its symmetry policy and retained kernel; show compatibility with refinement and the theta specialization.
conjectures.falsifier: Write a one-coordinate formula as though it automatically selected a channel of Z^D.
conjectures.next_action: Compare a source-selected channel with a symmetric quotient; state which operations each permits and test the required square.
conjectures.deliverable: Declared selection rule and operation/refinement comparison.
conjectures.verdict_scope: Explicitly pointed universal lattice and licensed axis task only; mark not native-forced, higher-degree triangulation atoms can read zero, canonical and physical selection not supplied.
Fixed six-active Gaussian-jet preparation and unchanged source Hamiltonian; radical gate passes. Arithmetic equality is separately rejected, not inferred.
conjectures.statement: Specify a successor map/form/domain candidate that survives the exact kernel obstruction.
conjectures.scope: A changed map, restricted domain or independently justified changed form is a new candidate, not a relabelled old result.
conjectures.acceptance: Freeze (source, Q, R, admissible test preparation, domain, completion) and check ker R subset radical Q before analytic positivity work.
conjectures.falsifier: Either stored kernel witness survives, or the direct even-Gaussian test has zero proposed energy against the certified nonzero Weil value; a fitted quotient norm merely defines the desired answer.
conjectures.next_action: Freeze a new tuple, retaining both prior rejections. Reuse the six-coordinate reader where appropriate; test kernels and the even Gaussian before claiming arithmetic form identification.
conjectures.deliverable: Versioned candidate tuple, lineage to rejected candidate and exact kernel test receipt.

conjectures.counterexample: x0=E6 e0 maps exactly to f0; unchanged H(x0)=5 whereas the certified half-Weil value is approximately 2.104799795822351e-9. The kernel-safe preparation still fails form equality.
conjectures.verdict_scope: Only six-active-gaussian-jet.v1 with its fixed monomial basis and scale; no universal obstruction to other independently justified preparations.
conjectures.statement: Establish the actual Weil-form pullback for the frozen successor on its specified test domain and completion.
conjectures.scope: Use one normalization and source-defined forms; include continuity, density and limit transport.
conjectures.acceptance: Prove Q(f,g)=b_Weil(Rf,Rg) on a generating domain and justify extension, retaining prime/gamma/endpoint contributions.
conjectures.falsifier: The two forms disagree on a domain vector, or equality exists only by replacing the independently specified source form.
conjectures.next_action: After the kernel gate, compare polarized forms on explicit source-generated tests before extending to the completion.
conjectures.deliverable: Form-comparison witness with domain/normalization and extension argument.

conjectures.statement: The mathematical RH realization and proposed physical-process realization transport the same licensed continuations from one witness.
conjectures.scope: Fixed resources, history retention and source operations; continuous and discrete comparisons separately typed.
conjectures.acceptance: State/action/resource diagrams commute, including an equal-readout/different-continuation pair and reconstruction of retained distinctions.
conjectures.falsifier: Routes need different source choices, unavailable operations, or discard a continuation claimed to be preserved.
conjectures.next_action: Use the rank-one Riemann readout with two different retained source states to test the exact task-relative identity claimed.
conjectures.deliverable: Same-witness comparison and explicit continuation counterexample controls.

conjectures.statement: Assemble the bounded RH stagewise mathematical-realization example for the mathematical branch.
conjectures.scope: Existing operations and analytic completions with declared choices; form repair is a separate branch, not a prerequisite for this bounded assembly.
conjectures.acceptance: Review typed stage witnesses, overlap maps, retained records and completion arguments against the branch interface.
conjectures.falsifier: Different stages use incompatible types or meanings of identity.
conjectures.next_action: Compose the typed interface witnesses and attach the result to rh-mathematical-realization-example.

conjectures.statement: Assemble the selected RH same-source candidate with compatible mathematical, continuation and form witnesses.
conjectures.scope: The explicitly selected RH comparison, not an implication from unrelated successful examples.
conjectures.acceptance: All three witnesses refer to the same source/map/domain conventions and their overlap comparisons compose.
conjectures.falsifier: Each branch succeeds on a different source or incompatible completion.
conjectures.next_action: Review same-witness compatibility after the three incoming gates close; attach to rh-same-source-compatibility-example.

legacy_frontiers.relation: Parallel RH routes preserved verbatim, not prerequisites of the new Fourier/common-source tasks.
